newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyosung Group targets '97 sales at nine trln won.
newsitem.headline: Hyosung Group targets '97 sales at nine trln won.

text.p: South Korea's Hyosung Group said on Thursday it forecast 1997 sales at nine trillion won, compared with an estimated 7.5 trillion won in 1996.
Hyosung Group said in a statement that it would raise its investment by 14.4 percent to 1.03 trillion won in 1997 from an estimated 900 billion this year.

It said the group detailed next year's investment plan as including 250 billion won to petrochemical sectors, 220 billion won to synthetic fiber sectors, 150 billion won to information and communication businesses, 80 billion won to industrial machinery sectors and 100 billion won to transportation and new projects.
Comparable figures for 1996 investment were not given.
